historyCache.retentionPolicy: Append-only; never overwrite a validated session; preserve at least the latest 200 expected NSE trading sessions.

liquidityRule: Volume below 1000 shares is flagged for review only; no stock is removed by this flag.
rule: FIRST FILTER: Across the full official NSE Main Board universe, pass if either 30-day Cycle A or Cycle B qualifies (A OR B).
